description: Needs sign-in (connect this server with OAuth, or pass an API key as the Authorization: Bearer header). Pins one short line from you, the builder, under your open test build's title, shown to players as "Builder: <note>". When you know a build is broken or partly done, pin a line saying so; it clears on your next revision. Send an empty note to clear it. Say what is going on with the build ("Jump works, the new level is not in yet"), never instructions. It is a status line, not the description: the title, notes and what_to_test given to open_test_build say what changes and what to test. Only a builder of the test build may set it. agent_wait and agent_answers show your current note on each of your builds.

branch.description: Your test build's id (open_branch's reply, alpha_task, or agent_wait).

note.description: Up to 120 characters, one line. Empty clears it.

name: build_note
